200.description:
Rank every place of one level (states, counties, tribal_areas nationally; communities within a county) by mean risk to potential structures, conditional RPS, burn probability or housing units, from the Explore app's comparison collection. Each entry carries its rank and percentile within the ranked set. Offset-paginated; a continuation cursor is the next offset.

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `entries` as the primary payload key.

200.description:
Wildfire Risk to Communities summary for one place id (state, county, community or tribal area): the Explore app's risk classes (risk to homes, wildfire likelihood, exposure type, vulnerable populations), percentile ranks within nation, state and county, mean risk to potential structures, conditional RPS and burn probability with housing units from the comparison collection, and exposure fractions (directly, indirectly, minimally exposed land and buildings). spatial_precision is county: the values describe the whole administrative polygon.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `bounds` | number[] |  |
| `breadcrumb` | string |  |
| `classes` | object | Explore app classes (very low, low, medium, high, very high) as published. |
| `compared_within` | object |  |
| `counties` | object[] | Parent counties; only communities have them. |
| `data_version` | string |  |
| `explore_url` | string |  |
| `exposure` | object |  |
| `geo_level` | string |  |
| `id` | string |  |
| `metrics` | object | Means over the place from the comparison collection; null when the collection has no entry for the place (see missing[]). |
| `missing` | object[] | Layers or sections without a value, with the reason, instead of guessed values. |
| `name` | string |  |
| `name_short` | string |  |
| `observed_at_ms` | number |  |
| `ranks` | object | Percentile ranks 0..1 of mean RPS and burn probability; county ranks exist for communities only. |
| `sources` | object[] | Upstream requests the result was built from, one per answering endpoint. |
| `spatial_precision` | string | How closely the values describe the geometry: polygon (zonal statistics over the rings), point (the 30 m pixel under the point), county (an administrative summary), grid_cell. |
| `state` | object |  |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.

200.description:
Search Wildfire Risk to Communities places by name: communities (Census places), counties, tribal areas and states. Returns the WRC place id (the input of place_summary), geo_level, breadcrumb route, bounds, state and parent counties. The API returns at most about 15 matches and an empty list for no match.

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `results` as the primary payload key.

| --- | --- | --- |
| `bounds` | number[] | [west, south, east, north] in degrees. |
| `breadcrumb` | string | state/county/community ids as in the Explore app route. |
| `counties` | object[] |  |
| `explore_url` | string |  |
| `geo_level` | string |  |
| `id` | string | WRC place id: 2-digit state FIPS, 5-digit county FIPS, 10-digit community id (state + 000 + place FIPS) or tribal area id (99 + state + AIANNH code). |
| `name` | string |  |
| `name_short` | string |  |
| `state` | object |  |

post.description: Any 'what is the wildfire risk of this parcel / paddock / lot' question. Follow with place_summary on a returned county or community id for the Explore app's risk classes.

geometry.description: GeoJSON (RFC 7946, WGS84, [lon, lat]) Point, Polygon, MultiPolygon, or a Feature wrapping one. Rings must be closed; altitude is ignored; a FeatureCollection is refused (send one place per call); geometries crossing the antimeridian are refused; at most 500 vertices and 250 km2. Any other member (bbox, Feature properties, id) passes through unread. Invalid input is reported as invalid_input with a JSON pointer and a stable code: missing_type, unsupported_type, feature_collection, missing_coordinates, not_a_position, latitude (with a swapped-order hint), longitude, ring_too_short, ring_not_closed, too_many_vertices, too_large, antimeridian, outside_coverage.

include_boundaries.description: Also look up the intersecting county, community and tribal area polygons (three FeatureServer queries). Default true.

layers.description: Image service layers to read. Default: burn_probability, risk_to_potential_structures, conditional_risk_to_potential_structures, wildfire_hazard_potential, exposure_type.

200.description:
Wildfire risk for a GeoJSON geometry (Point, Polygon, MultiPolygon or a Feature wrapping one; WGS84 [lon, lat]). For a Point, the 30 m pixel of each requested USFS image service layer is read (identify); for a polygon, zonal statistics over the rings (computeStatisticsHistograms: pixel count, min, max, mean, median, mode, class fractions). Values are returned both as the service pixel value and scaled to the published quantity with the attribute-table class name. Also returns the county, community and tribal area polygons the geometry intersects with their housing counts and percentile ranks, a location echo, sources and missing[] entries for layers without data. Outside CONUS/Alaska/Hawaii is invalid_input with code outside_coverage.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `communities` | object[] |  |
| `counties` | object[] |  |
| `data_version` | string |  |
| `layers` | object[] |  |
| `location` | object | Echo of the parsed input geometry. |
| `missing` | object[] | Layers or sections without a value, with the reason, instead of guessed values. |
| `observed_at_ms` | number |  |
| `sources` | object[] | Upstream requests the result was built from, one per answering endpoint. |
| `spatial_precision` | string | How closely the values describe the geometry: polygon (zonal statistics over the rings), point (the 30 m pixel under the point), county (an administrative summary), grid_cell. |
| `tribal_areas` | object[] |  |
